settings.info: These colors control the paper ground, heading ink, and the signal that marks a measured value. The reversed green field, the steel chrome accent and the live-readout trace are structural and are not merchant-editable.

settings.label: Legacy font picker (unused)
settings.info: CaddieInsight loads Barlow, Barlow Condensed and DM Mono in theme.liquid to match the app. This picker is retained for theme editor compatibility only.

settings.content: Barlow Condensed carries display type and Barlow the interface. Because Barlow ships no variable font, the interface uses only regular and medium — a rule that wants more weight reaches for the condensed face instead. DM Mono marks measured evidence (chips, dosages, specimen labels). The same three faces ship on app.caddieinsight.com, byte for byte.
